title: Preserve the architecture change behind exponential error
statement: An absorbing OUTLET retaining the ENTIRE logical space, excitation proportional to U and data-independent helper decay makes every completed emission implement U, with epsilon(T)<=C^2 exp(-2lambda T). This changes the old star-only absorbing LOSS-flag architecture, so its1/epsilon lower bound is not universal. Helper preparation/reset and the microscopic common coupler remain paid/unearned respectively. Dissipative computation and exponential discrete gates have prior art; no generic advantage over equally informed calibrated exchange/holonomic/Zeno control is established. Blockade hardware labels alone do not guarantee preservation of all three triplets.
